demand_suggestions.label: Take Hanover from Britain
demand_suggestions.reason_display: Hanover sits beside what we already hold; Britain would keep it only on paper.

demand_suggestions.label: Demand 300 gold from Britain
demand_suggestions.reason_display: Britain's treasury can bear 300 gold — priced to wound the purse, not the pride.

demand_suggestions.label: Demand 100 gold a turn from Britain for 3 turns
demand_suggestions.reason_display: A tribute of 100 gold a turn for 3 turns — collected quietly, resented slowly, and well within Britain's means.

demand_suggestions.label: Vassalize Britain
demand_suggestions.reason_display: At 30% of our strength, Britain is better acquired than argued with.

demand_suggestions.label: Subjugate Britain
demand_suggestions.reason_display: At 30% of our strength, Britain cannot decline a master; subjugation merely sets it down in ink.

demand_suggestions.label: Force Britain into alliance
demand_suggestions.reason_display: An alliance signed under necessity still signs, Sire — Britain's weight moves to our side of the ledger.

concession_baseline.reasoning: Sire, the concession draft — France would pay Britain 500 gold, cede Waterloo to Britain, and pay Prussia 500 gold — would lift acceptance toward Britain and Prussia. It is what the field asks of us.

recurring_gold_preset.reasoning: Sire, the draft commits France to 10 gold per turn to Britain for 3 turns (30 gold in total). Recurring payments steady the peace; they also tie the treasury for years.
